title: The Eye of Heavenly Dao Descends
next_chapter_hook: "Within the trial space, the scene Chen Ji feared most was materializing—the Heavenly Dao had prepared a death rehearsal just for him, a complete process of witnessing his own complete annihilation."

text.content: "At the entrance to the ninth level ruins of the Tianji Record, the void was torn apart as if by an invisible giant hand, a deep rift stretching across heaven and earth, intertwined rays of azure blue and dark gold spilling out from within. A dilapidated ancient altar stood before him, its mottled stone surface bearing traces of archaic inscriptions, each incision bearing the weight of ages."

"Chen Ji stood at the altar's edge, the Tianji Record Fragment at his brow center faintly scalding. He raised his head toward that rift, his eyes reflecting the light within—a materialization of Heavenly Dao's laws, a pressure transcending the mortal realm. He could sense his Heavenly Fate Value trembling violently, as if some existence was examining everything about him."

"Deep within the rift, two golden eyes slowly opened. That gaze pierced endless void, like two suns suspended above the heavens, scorching yet cold, majestic yet cruel. The Eye of Heavenly Dao—Chen Ji's mind flashed this name, his pupils contracting. He had known of this existence, yet hadn't expected to witness it at this moment."

dialogue.content: "'Chen Ji, servant disciple of Tianqing Sect, thief who stole the Tianji Record Fragment.' The voice didn't travel through his eardrums but exploded directly within Chen Ji's Mental Sea, as if the Heavenly Dao itself was pronouncing judgment, 'From this day forth, your existence has been marked. Within three months, I shall personally complete the reckoning.'"

text.content: "The moment those golden eyes locked onto Chen Ji, an utterly bone-deep chill spread from the soles of his feet to the crown of his head. This was a gaze surpassing realms, surpassing strength—a俯瞰 treating mortals as ants. Chen Ji felt every hair on his body trembling, the Tianji Record Fragment in his Mental Sea quaking violently, as if issuing a silent warning."

"Fear. This was the first genuine fear Chen Ji had experienced since his cultivation began. He could face Han Lie's brute force, could face Ling Yuan's hidden daggers and schemes, could even face Su Qingyao's pursuit and interrogation—but now, facing a direct gaze from the Heavenly Dao level, he realized for the first time his own insignificance and humility."

"'Recorded.' Chen Ji silently recited in his heart, his fingernails digging deep into his palms, blood dripping between his fingers. He told himself this wasn't cowardice, but a clear-eyed recognition of the situation. The Heavenly Dao wanted to settle accounts with him—Fine, he would wait. But before that, he must become stronger, strong enough that even the Heavenly Dao would have to weigh the cost."

"Just then, the altar shuddered violently, and the ancient inscriptions lit up one by one. The rift expanded, and a pitch-black gateway fully took shape. Within the portal lay endless chaos and void, and deep within that chaos, a massive stone platform loomed indistinctly—the entrance to the final trial of the ruins."

"'The Ultimate Trial begins.' The Eye of Heavenly Dao's voice rang out again, this time carrying a kind of playful cruelty, 'The assessment content—face your fears. You shall witness with your own eyes the complete process of your annihilation. If after witnessing you can still maintain an unshattered Dao heart, the trial is passed. If your Dao heart collapses...'"

choice.prompt: "The Eye of Heavenly Dao's voice echoed in his Mental Sea, the trial entrance already open. Facing what might be a lethal trap, Chen Ji needed to make a choice:"

choices.description: "Step into the trial, witness the death rehearsal the Heavenly Dao prepared for him. Endure the most extreme fear with a fearless heart."
choices.visible_reward: "Trial reward: Heavenly Dao Law Comprehension Fragment"
choices.risk_hint: "If Dao heart collapses, cultivation foundation will be completely lost"

text.content: "Chen Ji drew a deep breath and stepped forward. He told himself that a true chess master never fears seeing the outcome—because the outcome is merely part of the chess game. He wanted to see with his own eyes what tricks the Heavenly Dao could possibly pull."

choices.description: "Temporarily retreat from the entrance, observe the trial mechanism before deciding. Preserve strength, seek other breakthrough points."
choices.risk_hint: "The Eye of Heavenly Dao may intensify the reckoning"

text.content: "Chen Ji's foot paused, stepping back half a pace. He needed more information. Though the Eye of Heavenly Dao seemed omniscient, Chen Ji never believed a truly unsolvable situation existed in this world. Observation, waiting, calculation—these were the things he excelled at."

"Before his words even finished, a磅礴 suction force suddenly surged from within the portal, dragging Chen Ji's entire body into the chaos. Wind howled past his ears, the world spun, and instinctively he operated his Spiritual Energy to stabilize his form, only to discover that even Spiritual Energy was suppressed to near nothingness within this chaotic space."

"When Chen Ji opened his eyes again, he found himself in an empty stone chamber. The walls around were smooth as mirrors, reflecting his pallid features. And in the chamber's center, a illusory figure was slowly taking form—the silhouette's outline was identical to his own."

"'Is this the trial?' Chen Ji stared at that phantom, his voice low, 'Using myself to frighten myself?' Yet no sooner had the words left his mouth than the phantom suddenly opened its eyes—those eyes held no emotion whatsoever, only pure, transcendent Heavenly Dao Will."

dialogue.content: "'Chen Ji, your death has been pre-scheduled.' The phantom spoke, its voice identical to the Eye of Heavenly Dao, 'Now, you shall witness with your own eyes how you will be annihilated—from soul to flesh, from past to future, completely erased from all records in the world.'"

text.content: "The four walls of the stone chamber blazedsuddenly, countless scenes flickering like a carousel. Chen Ji saw himself—crushed by Heavenly Dao power in the void, bones shattered, flesh and blood a mess; he saw Su Qingyao's grief-stricken face as she collected his body; he saw Chen Nian's despair-filled eyes upon learning the tragic news."

"No! Chen Ji wanted to look away, but found his body completely immobilized. He was forced to watch every detail of his own death—the Heavenly Dao even slowed the images, allowing him to clearly feel every ounce of pain, every thread of despair. It was meticulously designed torment, ayang plot meant to utterly destroy his Dao heart."

choice.prompt: "The death images continued, and Chen Ji's Dao heart was enduring an unprecedented assault. At this critical moment, he had to make a choice:"

choices.description: "The Heavenly Dao wanted to crush him with fear? He refused to give the Heavenly Dao what it wanted. Respond to this clumsy psychological offensive with a cold laugh."
choices.risk_hint: "The Heavenly Dao may intensify annihilation efforts"

text.content: "'Is this the Heavenly Dao's method?' Chen Ji suddenly burst into laughter, the sound echoing in the stone chamber, 'Threatening mortals with death, destroying Dao hearts with fear—ridiculous! If I, Chen Ji, were a man who feared death, I wouldn't have accepted the Tianji Record in the first place!'"

choices.description: "The fear was real, but Chen Ji would not be dominated by fear. He rapidly analyzed the flaws in this illusion within his Mental Sea."

text.content: "Chen Ji forced himself to calm down. This wasn't a true death rehearsal, merely an illusion. He silently recited the Tianji Record incantations in his heart, attempting to find the illusion's boundaries. The Heavenly Dao wanted to shatter him with fear, but it overlooked one point—he had long grown accustomed to walking on the edge of a blade."

"Just then, the phantom spoke again: 'Fear is a mortal's instinct, but what I give you is not imagination—but an inevitably occurring future. None of the Tianji Record's inheritors have escaped the fate of reckoning. Your past life was the same, and you... will be too.'"

"Chen Ji's pupilsslightly一缩. Past life? The information revealed in the Eye of Heavenly Dao's words stirred his heart. Could it be that before him, there were other Tianji Record inheritors annihilated by the Heavenly Dao? This information was never recorded in the Tianji Record Fragment, and Mo Xiansheng had never mentioned it either."

"The phantom seemed to sense Chen Ji's wavering, its assault growing more凌厉: 'You think yourself a chess player? No, you are merely a piece the Tianji Record selected. And I am the one who moves the pieces. Every fragment of the Tianji Record in this world is a piece I have placed—including you.'"

choice.prompt: "The Heavenly Dao phantom's words were like blades, cutting layer upon layer at Chen Ji's mental defenses. At this most critical moment, Chen Ji must make his final choice:"

choices.description: "No matter how the Heavenly Dao defines him, he will not accept a pre-arranged ending. The Tianji Record is in his hands, and he will write a new Tianji."
choices.visible_cost: "Completely become an enemy of the Heavenly Dao"
choices.risk_hint: "Future reckoning will be even more cruel"

text.content: "Chen Ji slowly raised his head, the fear in his eyes already dissipated, replaced by an icy glow. 'Pieces placed by the Heavenly Dao?' His voice was terrifyingly calm, 'Then let this piece of yours, overturn this chess game of yours.'"

choices.description: "Openly confronting the Heavenly Dao wasn't a wise move. He chose to temporarily endure, secretly seeking a method to break the situation."
choices.visible_cost: "May be seen through by the Heavenly Dao"
choices.risk_hint: "The Heavenly Dao may sense his true intentions"

text.content: "Chen Ji收敛眼底edge, putting on an expression of being crushed by fear. '...I understand.' He said softly, his voice slightly trembling. The phantom, upon seeing this, seemed to show a satisfied expression, unaware that within Chen Ji's heart, possibilities for counterattack were being rapidly calculated."

"The moment Chen Ji made his choice, the entire stone chamber shook violently. The phantom's expression changed for the first time—that was anger, disbelief, and... a hidden wariness. The death images on the stone walls suddenly shattered, dissolving into countless light specks that scattered into the void."

"'You...' The phantom's voice carried a unprecedented fluctuation, 'You actually managed to withstand my first wave of assault!' Chen Ji didn't answer; he felt the Tianji Record Fragment dancing wildly in his Mental Sea, as if responding to something. That was a power beyond his comprehension awakening."

"Within the trial space, brilliant light flourished. When Chen Ji opened his eyes again, he found himself standing on a massive stone platform—the very trial core he had seen earlier in the depths of chaos. Countless ancient runes were inscribed around the platform, each rune emanating a faint golden glow."

"Chen Ji lowered his head to look at his hands and discovered a faint mark on his palm—the proof of resonance between the Tianji Record Fragment and the trial space. Within the mark was contained a fragment of... memory not belonging to him. He saw a blurred figure—that was the previous inheritor of the Tianji Record."

"So that's how it is. Chen Ji finally understood why the Tianji Record Fragment had chosen him, why it would awaken within him. That wasn't merely fortune, but a kind of... inheritance and resistance. When the wills of successive inheritors gathered together, the Tianji Record gained the capital to compete with the Heavenly Dao."

"'Interesting.' Chen Ji murmured to himself, a meaningful arc curving at the corner of his mouth, 'The Heavenly Dao wanted to crush me with fear, but never expected that successive inheritors of the Tianji Record all planted seeds of rebellion within me. From this perspective, your so-called 'certain kill' doesn't seem quite so absolute.'"

"Above the stone platform, a illusory portal slowly manifested—the exit from the trial space. Chen Ji knew he had passed the first trial. But this was merely the beginning; now that the Eye of Heavenly Dao had noticed him, the true reckoning would only grow closer."

"The moment before stepping through the portal, Chen Ji turned to look into the depths of the void at that pair of golden eyes. The two gazes collided in the emptiness, one representing Heavenly Dao majesty, the other carrying rebellious will. This wasn't an ending, but a beginning—Chen Ji's game of chess with the Heavenly Dao had officially begun."

"The portal's light engulfed Chen Ji, and when he opened his eyes again, he stood on the plain outside the ruins. Night wind brushed his face, carrying the distinctive scent of wild grass and vegetation. In the distance, the silhouette of Tianqing Sect loomed indistinctly under moonlight—that was the sanctuary he could temporarily rely upon."
